title: CNN/attention ensembles: independent 2026 BTC confirmation
question: Evaluate forecasts from a pre-training-frozen CNN/attention research plan, selected only on 2025 Q4 validation and tested on January-September 2026. Three-seed CNN ensembles are compared with GRU and ridge; signs and 80/90/95 percentile trading thresholds are calibrated on validation, with abstention when no eligible threshold is profitable. The L3 layer replays evaluation of pinned forecasts, not GPU retraining. Research success requires H1/H2/H4 supported and positive stress PNL; this is not the original proprietary equity task.

hypotheses.statement: The validation-selected CNN ensemble has positive global held-out Pearson IC after validation-only sign calibration.
hypotheses.falsifier: The fourteen-day block-bootstrap global-correlation interval is wholly negative; intervals containing zero are inconclusive.

hypotheses.statement: The validation-selected CNN threshold strategy has positive mean daily arithmetic PNL after two basis points per leg and fixed-notional funding accrual.
hypotheses.falsifier: The fourteen-day block interval is wholly negative; intervals including zero or fewer than one hundred test trades are inconclusive.

hypotheses.statement: Negative economic control: increasing the cost per leg from two to five basis points on fixed trades increases PNL.
hypotheses.falsifier: At least one trade and increased costs lower PNL; if abstaining the verdict is inconclusive.

hypotheses.statement: The validation-selected CNN ensemble improves global test Pearson IC over the three-seed GRU reference, with signs calibrated only on validation.
hypotheses.falsifier: The paired fourteen-day block-bootstrap IC-difference interval is wholly negative; zero-containing intervals are inconclusive.
